HexKagune 1.3.9 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 58: update both). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- New gender screen: the eye placement screen's Done button is now Next, and it opens "Who are you?": Male or Female, then Done (Back returns to the eyes). Change it any time with /kagune eyes, then Next.
- Female players get Eto's exact body: drawn at 0.86 size, slim arms (wide-arm skins are slimmed), wider and deeper hips, and her bust, painted from your own skin's chest (with your jacket layer over it) and bouncing as you move. The bust isn't drawn through a chestplate.
- Female players' hitbox and eye height shrink to 0.86 too (about 1.55 blocks tall), on both server and client, so hits land where you're drawn. No new gaps open up.
- Eto now uses the same shared female body; every female NPC to come will too. She looks the same as before.
- Your gender is saved in your profile (kept through death) and sent to everyone who sees you.
- Holding hands with Eto as a woman: she stands a little closer, so your slimmer, smaller arms still meet.
- Male is drawn exactly as before; players who haven't picked are unchanged.
